A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same EditMGT research work, with readable main text, Appendices A–E, equations, figures, tables, and references. All 47 pages align; rendered differences are confined to pages 1, 3, and 39.

before.justification: v1 reports original EditMGT benchmark results, qualitative evaluations, ablations, attention analyses, and captioning experiments in Section 4 and the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the benchmark comparisons in Tables 1–2 and the appendix experiments in Tables 4–7.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same attention injection, multi-layer attention consolidation, region-hold sampling, training objective, and three-stage training procedure.

E1.justification: The training mixture in Table 3, four image-editing benchmarks, CapsBench captioning evaluation, and GenEval ablations retain identical dataset and task coverage.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons in Tables 1–2, 4, 6–7 and Figure 5 contain the same comparator methods. No baseline is added, removed, or replaced.

E3.justification: Training budgets, resolutions, evaluation metrics, benchmark procedures, ablation configurations, and timing protocols in Section 3.3 and Appendix C are unchanged.

E4.justification: The data-scaling, encoder/connector, and sampling-threshold studies remain identical, as do Appendix B's attention visualizations and smoothing comparisons. No analysis or case study is added or removed.

E5.justification: Appendix C.4 retains the same seed specifications, including seed 42 for MagicBrush and VAREdit. Neither version adds repeated-run reporting, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative examples are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains EditMGT CLIPim scores of 0.878 on EMU Edit and 0.911 on MagicBrush; Table 2 retains its GEdit-EN-full average of 5.87.

T1.justification: Equations 1–18 and the mathematical comparison in Table 8 are identical. No mathematical definition, assumption, derivation, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution bullets, and conclusion retain the same claims. Changing 'three contributions' to 'four contributions' on page 3 corrects the count of four already-existing bullets; it introduces no new contribution.

C2.justification: Result interpretations, mechanism explanations, and limitations are unchanged. Appendix E.1 replaces 'ModelName' with 'EditMGT' without changing the surrounding broader-impact argument.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, preprocessing, and inference information remain identical. The project, code, and dataset links retain the same targets; only the arXiv version link changes.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix D, Table 8, and all 165 bibliography entries are unchanged. The novelty claims and positioning relative to diffusion, autoregressive, and masked generative models are retained.

P1.justification: v2 corrects 'three contributions' to 'four' and replaces the leftover 'ModelName' placeholder with 'EditMGT'. The arXiv version/date stamp is updated. No sections or substantive paragraphs are reorganized.

P2.justification: Replacing the placeholder with the styled model name produces localized typography and line-wrapping changes in Appendix E.1. All 20 figures and eight tables retain identical content, captions, and placement; overall page organization is unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 removes two small editorial blemishes: the incorrect contribution count and the model-name placeholder. These corrections modestly polish presentation but leave the scientific content, supporting evidence, reproducibility information, and limitations unchanged, producing no meaningful overall quality difference.
